heroHeadline: CDC count reaches 5,182 measles cases as PAHO elimination review nears
heroSubtitle: CDC counts 5,182 confirmed 2026 cases (+330 in a week, the 13th straight triple-digit rise), 96% outbreak-associated across 47 jurisdictions. Pennsylvania reported its sixth measles-associated death; states count eight 2026 deaths versus the CDC's four. PAHO's commission meets next week and the US is expected to lose elimination status.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
